Dear Hiring Committee,

I am excited to apply for the Program Coordinator position at Greenway Trust. For the past four years I have managed volunteer programs at the Riverbend Conservancy, where I recruited and trained over 200 volunteers.

I beleive my experience organising community events would be a strong fit for this role. I have attached my CV and two references.

Yours faithfully,
Imogen Clarke

labels.notes: en-GB: "organising" is correct British spelling and must not be flagged.
